# The Grey Mother

The growing tip of a mother root nobody ever mapped, grey and soft all through, as thick as a house. It has no mind. It grows toward warmth, and the warmest thing in the riverbank tonight is two hundred people.

It fights as the floor and the walls of the hollow. It never moves, and its Acts reach anywhere down there. It is strong and spell-proof, and a blade finds it, because its Precision and Evasion are 0. Its signature Ensnared is the root closing over a Fell's hands. The Fell do not need to bring it to 0. Sealing the shaft with stone defeats it, as the scene sets out.

## What it wants

Warmth, and nothing else. It is a rotten root with no mind. It grows toward the warmest thing near it, and that is two hundred people in a riverbank.

## Getting past it without a fight

There is no way to talk to it. The way past it is stone: wall the shaft off and it is cut off from the warren. That is how the fight is won.
